name: clip
summary: 6 key moments, 2 jumps: ready -> crouch left arm forward -> jump -> land -> left leg landing stance -> deep crouch -> rising left arm back -> jump -> land -> crouch left arm forward -> standing left foot back (finish)
action: The body bends into a deep crouch, jumps airborne with both feet off the ground, lands, and rises to stand, repeating the sequence twice.

stages.name: crouch left arm forward
stages.description: The body bends the knees and hips into a deep crouch while reaching both arms down and forward.

stages.name: left leg landing stance
stages.description: The body jumps upward airborne and then lands onto the feet into a shallow bent-knee stance.

stages.name: deep crouch
stages.description: The body bends the knees and hips back down into a deep crouch with arms lowered.

stages.name: rising left arm back
stages.description: The body starts to rise from the crouch while drawing the left arm back in preparation for takeoff.

stages.name: crouch left arm forward
stages.description: The body jumps upward airborne and then lands back into a deep crouch with the left arm forward.

stages.name: standing left foot back (finish)
stages.description: The body rises from the crouch to an upright standing position with feet together.

notes: Progress toward the next key moment pays as it happens, gated on staying upright.
Each key moment reached pays a bonus; a jump pays extra for its height.
Finishing pays a bonus scaled by the moments reached.
Once done, holding the end pose pays per second, and the style terms stop.
A fall gives back what the attempt earned since the last steady stance.
Timing is free: only the order of the moments counts.
Optional moments pay too, but may be skipped.
